## Security

### Claude Mythos AI cracks HAWK post-quantum cryptography in 60 hours
<span class="imp imp-5" title="Importance 5/5" aria-label="Importance 5 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i></span> Anthropic's Claude Mythos AI model cracked a NIST post-quantum cryptography candidate, HAWK, in about 60 hours, finding a flaw that had survived two years of expert review and prompting the algorithm's withdrawal from standardization.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Found &#x27;nontrivial automorphism&#x27; cutting HAWK-256 security from 2^64 to 2^38 operations</li>
<li>Only the 256-bit challenge variant was tested, not 512/1024-bit production versions</li>
<li>Cost ~$100,000 in API expenses running semi-autonomously</li>
<li>Also devised &#x27;Möbius Bridge&#x27; technique improving attacks on 7-round AES-128 by 200-800x</li>
<li>HAWK&#x27;s authors withdrew their NIST submission within a day of disclosure on July 28</li>
</ul>

Sources: [TechTimes](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/321876/20260728/ai-cracks-post-quantum-cipher-60-hours-after-two-years-human-review-failed.htm) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4202920/mythos-takes-its-first-shot-at-post-quantum-cryptography.html) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/mythos-uncovers-crypto-weaknesses-that-went-unknown-for-years/) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>, [Startup Fortune](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOQk9aZDZIVURaOTkxUHpSSjk2TVFOZVVvUHdvb2pPWUhzRzRVQlJoUnZQNjFKM3gxcUNsd1BHWFk5cXVaSlRiMVItVFREYUV5ZW1GcUZJalIyYmxhenVRcG9MWW5KWTh0MVlLV3NpeGRGTTZneTFTQTlNbkEwR2kxcG1xRjYycUo1cTVEZ1paVXU2MVVlNzVyd0xEN21iTDVBd2pHNFNRRk51Zw?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>, [TweakTown](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNSlZDeTRlcjFEUmRhY05XcHppdGRITjJSOEpKRWJ1bkdjeV9MOUtNd2huejRWTDRNdjZZc0EtWXJMUjhoWFhWdEJiZG4wYXJORWdKSzRUMXVlalNGS1dMWE9rYVQwZHFVZDFXQ1JQeUk1aGFSOVFpMHRRUU53OUpRUU9MQm83cnhRR25kenBCbDNtYXRidXBfYm4ycnpHcEk4cHZNa2VkWXMzOGlNQ3ItSXpB?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>, [yellow.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTFBiZ09BMXBNQ0RrNFV6a1dLMXNEN0JxcUNyQVdaVUM5MmF1c1JRSGJCak1TbmJpRjRKdHZFcmtBS2dhNjY1ZXhremFPcDlBa2pYRUxfVGg3a1BuWjZWbUxEVVpHVmtnamc?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>
